tips.name: Kids and baby
items: JR trains: under 6 ride free with an adult (two per paying adult; a reserved seat for them costs the child fare), 6 to 11 pay half. Child Suica cards exist for ages 6 to 11.
Department stores have a nursing room and changing tables on the baby floor; station multipurpose restrooms (多目的トイレ) usually have a changing table.
Drugstores (Matsumoto Kiyoshi, Welcia, Sundrug) sell diapers, wipes, powdered and liquid formula and baby food pouches.
Stations have elevators, but not every exit does; look for the elevator icon on the station map before leaving the platform with the stroller.
Restaurants in Japan are often small with counter seating; ask for a table and whether the stroller can come in before you sit down.
